# pcd_compute_aggregate (Data Source)

Looks up a Nova host aggregate by name, including the aggregates PCD keeps for its clusters (named after the cluster). Requires an admin token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look an aggregate up by name, for example the one PCD keeps for a cluster
# (named after the cluster), to read its hosts.
data "pcd_compute_aggregate" "cluster" {
  name = "cluster-1"
}

output "cluster_hosts" {
  value = data.pcd_compute_aggregate.cluster.hosts
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The aggregate name, matched exactly. Nova keeps names unique.

### Optional

- `region` (String) The region. Defaults to the provider's region.

### Read-Only

- `hosts` (Set of String) The hypervisors in the aggregate, by resmgr host UUID.
- `id` (String) The Nova aggregate ID, a decimal integer.
- `metadata` (Map of String) The aggregate metadata, without the `availability_zone` key Nova mirrors from `zone`.
- `zone` (String) The aggregate's availability zone; null when it has none.
